activeAero.quote: DRS was removed from Formula One for the 2026 season, and was replaced with an "active aerodynamics" system under the new 2026 regulations.

aeroTestingRestriction.quote: In 2021, the championship introduced a sliding scale system to regulate aerodynamic testing.

budgetCap.quote: The championship introduced a budget cap, with teams limited to spending a maximum of $145 million per year.
budgetCap.note: Antes de 2021 no hubo techo de gasto

drs.quote: DRS was used in Formula One from 2011 to 2025, with Jenson Button and Andrea Kimi Antonelli being the first and the last to use it, respectively.

energySystem.quote: The kinetic energy recovery system—known from 2009 to 2013 as KERS, and renamed from 2014 as ERS-K—was incorporated into the design of the engine and its usage increased

engineFormula.quote: The new engines were a 1.6-litre V6 format with an 8-speed semi-automatic gearbox.

engineFormulas.note: Conjunto de fórmulas de los motores de f1db; el generador aborta si no coincide

parcFerme.quote: According to the FIA Formula One regulations (used since 2003), the area must be sufficiently large and secure so as to prevent unauthorised access to the cars, while allowing technical checks to take place.

pitLaneSpeed.quote: 80 km/h; Melbourne, Mónaco y Singapur 60 km/h (SIM-FISICA §4.4, V)

pointsScheme.quote: The final race of the season offered double points to teams and drivers in a bid to keep the championship fight alive for longer.
pointsScheme.note: Comprobado por el generador contra los puntos de cada resultado y las clasificaciones de f1db

refuelling.quote: Refuelling, now banned in F1 races, was permitted until 1983, and then again from the 1994 season to the 2009 season.

rule107.quote: The 107% rule was relaxed at the start of the season to account for teams dealing with the challenges that arose from the new engine regulations.

safetyCar.quote: Formula One officially introduced safety cars in 1993, after trials were conducted at both the French and British Grands Prix during the preceding 1992 season.

sprintWeekends.note: Rondas con resultados de sprint en f1db

teamOrdersBanned.quote: As of 2011, the team orders rule no longer appeared in the sporting regulations.

topTenStartTyres.quote: The rule that had been in place since 2014, requiring drivers that advance to the third segment of qualifying to start the race on the tyres they used to set their fastest time in the second segment of qualifying, was scrapped; all drivers now have free choice of starting tyre

tyreChangesInRace.quote: For 2006, following the dramatic and highly political 2005 United States Grand Prix, tyre changes were permitted again.

tyreType.quote: Slick tyres were reintroduced at the beginning of 2009, along with aerodynamic changes intended to shift the balance towards mechanical grip in an attempt to increase overtaking.

unitLimits.quote: Drivers were only able to use five engines over the course of a season in 2014, down from eight in 2013.

vsc.quote: The system was evolved taking into account drivers' feedback and was officially introduced for the 2015 season following ratification by the World Motor Sport Council (WMSC).

body.es: Rosberg gana en Melbourne; Ricciardo es descalificado por el caudal de combustible y Magnussen sube al podio en su debut.
body.en: Rosberg wins in Melbourne; Ricciardo is disqualified over fuel flow and Magnussen makes the podium on debut.

title.es: Sakhir: Hamilton y Rosberg luchan rueda a rueda bajo los focos
title.en: Sakhir: Hamilton and Rosberg fight wheel to wheel under the lights

body.es: Mercedes les deja competir y Hamilton gana.
body.en: Mercedes let them race and Hamilton wins.

title.es: Spa: Rosberg toca a Hamilton y gana Ricciardo
title.en: Spa: Rosberg touches Hamilton and Ricciardo wins

body.es: Mercedes reprende a Rosberg tras la carrera.
body.en: Mercedes reprimand Rosberg after the race.

title.es: Suzuka: Jules Bianchi sufre un grave accidente bajo la lluvia
title.en: Suzuka: Jules Bianchi suffers a serious crash in the rain

body.es: Su coche se sale y choca con una grúa que retiraba otro coche. Sufre lesiones cerebrales graves y fallece el 17 de julio de 2015. La investigación lleva a introducir el coche de seguridad virtual en 2015.
body.en: His car leaves the track and hits a recovery vehicle removing another car. He suffers severe head injuries and dies on 17 July 2015. The investigation leads to the virtual safety car from 2015.

title.en: The first Russian GP, in Sochi

body.es: Mercedes asegura el título de constructores.

title.es: Austin: Marussia y Caterham no acuden, en suspensión de pagos
title.en: Austin: Marussia and Caterham stay away, in administration

body.es: Marussia no vuelve en 2014; Caterham regresa en Abu Dabi gracias a una campaña de micromecenazgo.
body.en: Marussia do not return in 2014; Caterham come back in Abu Dhabi thanks to a crowdfunding campaign.

title.es: Abu Dabi: Hamilton, bicampeón en la carrera de puntos dobles
title.en: Abu Dhabi: Hamilton's second title, in the double-points race

body.es: Rosberg sufre problemas con el ERS y acaba fuera de los puntos.
body.en: Rosberg suffers ERS problems and finishes outside the points.
